lines.text: Pale gold light spills over the horizon onto empty wet sand.
@maya_front walks the waterline, barefoot, waves lapping at her ankles.
Her footprints fill with water behind her.
The light climbs, turning the sea from grey to gold.
@maya_front stops and looks out to sea.
She breathes in, and a slow smile arrives.
Gulls wheel over the glittering water.

writes.note: I drafted a quiet, visual dawn scene from your line, about 14 seconds.

reply.rationale: Expanded the single action line into a one-location, visual 15 s scene with seven short beats and no dialogue, keeping @maya_front as written.
